description.sr:
Napiši tip `MyPick<T, K>` koji pravi novi tip samo sa ključevima `K` iz tipa `T` (kao ugrađeni `Pick`, ali bez njegove upotrebe).

Primer:
```ts
type User = { id: number; name: string; age: number };
type Short = MyPick<User, 'id' | 'name'>; // { id: number; name: string }
```

Ne izvršava se nikakav kod: rešenje je tačno kad nema grešaka tipova.
description.en:
Write a type `MyPick<T, K>` that creates a new type with only the keys `K` of type `T` (like the built-in `Pick`, but without using it).

Example:
```ts
type User = { id: number; name: string; age: number };
type Short = MyPick<User, 'id' | 'name'>; // { id: number; name: string }
```

No code is executed: the solution is correct when there are no type errors.

starterCode: type MyPick<T, K extends keyof T> = unknown;
hiddenTests: type Case3 = Expect<Equal<MyPick<{ a: string }, 'a'>, { a: string }>>;

text.sr:
Početak aliasa i ograničenje ključeva.

- `type MyPick<T, K extends keyof T> = {` pravi alias (novo ime za tip) sa dva parametra tipa.
- `T` je tip objekta iz koga biramo svojstva, npr. `User`.
- `keyof T` je unija imena svih svojstava tipa `T`. Za `User = { id: number; name: string; age: number }` to je `'id' | 'name' | 'age'`.
- `K extends keyof T` znači: `K` mora biti podskup tih imena. Zato je `MyPick<User, 'email'>` greška, jer `'email'` ne postoji u `User`.
- `= {` otvara objektni tip koji se završava u liniji 3.
text.en:
The start of the alias and the key constraint.

- `type MyPick<T, K extends keyof T> = {` creates an alias (a new name for a type) with two type parameters.
- `T` is the type of the object we pick properties from, e.g. `User`.
- `keyof T` is the union of the names of all properties of `T`. For `User = { id: number; name: string; age: number }` it is `'id' | 'name' | 'age'`.
- `K extends keyof T` means: `K` must be a subset of those names. That is why `MyPick<User, 'email'>` is an error, because `'email'` does not exist in `User`.
- `= {` opens an object type that ends on line 3.

text.sr:
Mapirani tip: ovde nastaje rezultat.

- `[P in K]` prolazi kroz svaki član unije `K` i za svaki pravi jedno svojstvo čije je ime `P`. Za `K = 'id' | 'name'` nastaju svojstva `id` i `name`.
- `T[P]` je **indeksni pristup**: tip svojstva `P` u originalnom tipu `T`. Tako svojstvo zadržava svoj tip (`id` ostaje `number`).
- `;` završava član objektnog tipa.

Kako se računa `MyPick<User, 'id' | 'name'>`:

```
T = { id: number; name: string; age: number }
K = 'id' | 'name'

P = 'id'   → svojstvo id:   T['id']   = number
P = 'name' → svojstvo name: T['name'] = string

rezultat: { id: number; name: string }   (age je izostavljen)
```
text.en:
A mapped type: this is where the result is created.

- `[P in K]` goes through each member of the union `K` and creates one property for each, named `P`. For `K = 'id' | 'name'` the properties `id` and `name` are created.
- `T[P]` is an **indexed access**: the type of property `P` in the original type `T`. This way the property keeps its type (`id` stays `number`).
- `;` ends a member of the object type.

How `MyPick<User, 'id' | 'name'>` is computed:

```
T = { id: number; name: string; age: number }
K = 'id' | 'name'

P = 'id'   → property id:   T['id']   = number
P = 'name' → property name: T['name'] = string

result: { id: number; name: string }   (age is left out)
```

text.sr:
Zatvara objektni tip.

- `}` zatvara tip otvoren u liniji 1.
- `;` završava deklaraciju aliasa.
text.en:
Closes the object type.

- `}` closes the type opened on line 1.
- `;` ends the alias declaration.

note.sr: Mapirani tip prolazi kroz svaki ključ iz `K` i uzima njegov tip iz `T`.
note.en: A mapped type iterates over every key in `K` and takes its type from `T`.
